objective: Preserve original-request authorization across multi-agent handoffs by allowing only policy-bounded or attenuated scopes, selectively disclosing approved memory, and emitting explicit Allow, Require-Confirmation, or Deny verdicts.

research_inputs.finding: Portable agent memory requires provenance-verified transfer, capability-scoped selective disclosure, and an injection-resistant re-hydration pipeline that verifies, filters, ranks, compresses, formats, frames, and only then injects memory.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: FAISAL verifies disclosed memory digests and a disclosure budget at handoff admission; this contract does not transfer, retrieve, frame, or inject memory.

research_inputs.finding: MasDrift makes authorization preservation measurable across multi-agent architectures and formalizes Allow, Require-Confirmation, and Deny verdicts. Delegated policy may be preserved or narrowed but never widened; original-request anchoring reduces unauthorized actions.
research_inputs.implementation_impact: FAISAL adds original-request and source-policy anchoring, monotonic scope attenuation, policy-classified verdicts, provenance checks, and replay/freshness fences.

features: selective memory disclosure digest and budget checks
task, generation, freshness, trace, replay, and authority fences
receipt-only verdict output with memory_transferred=false and capabilities_delegated=false

benchmark.scope: local Python control-plane admission overhead; excludes memory transfer, capability issuance, agent execution, tools, network, storage, and production approval latency

limitations: The contract verifies caller-supplied provenance and digest references; it does not independently authenticate agents or cryptographically issue capabilities.
The contract emits a verdict but does not perform an actual handoff, transfer memory, delegate capabilities, or invoke a reference monitor.
The benchmark does not establish unauthorized-action rates, handoff completion, memory quality, tool success, AGI capability, production efficacy, or Linux superiority.
No physical hardware, external reviewer, independent builder, live multihost environment, or production approval was exercised.

rollback.rollback_scope: remove the handoff-authorization module, tests, benchmark, runner, evidence registration, and metadata; retain the route-receipt release tag
